projects.name: Loan Application Processing & Credit Underwriting Transformation
details: Partnering with Lending Operations, Risk, Compliance, Underwriting, and Data Science teams to modernize the end-to-end
loan origination and application processing lifecycle using Generative AI and Intelligent Automation solutions.
• Lead requirements gathering and business process analysis for AI-enabled loan processing workflows covering customer
onboarding, document intake, KYC verification, income assessment, credit evaluation, and underwriting support.
• Collaborate with AI/ML teams to implement Intelligent Document Processing (IDP) solutions leveraging OCR, NLP, Large
Language Models (LLMs), and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures for automated extraction and validation
of loan application documents.
• Define business rules, data classification frameworks, and metadata requirements for processing financial statements,
income proofs, bank statements, tax documents, identity verification documents, and supporting loan artifacts.
• Drive the design and implementation of Agentic AI workflows capable of orchestrating multi-step loan assessment activities
including document verification, exception handling, fraud checks, policy validation, and underwriting recommendations.
• Coordinate cross-functional teams for data mapping, vector database preparation, document chunking strategies,
embeddings generation, knowledge base creation, and AI model training readiness.
• Support synthetic data generation initiatives to enhance model training, testing, validation, and performance benchmarking
while maintaining regulatory and data privacy standards.
• Define user stories, business requirements, acceptance criteria, and workflow specifications for AI copilots and
underwriting assistants supporting lending operations teams.
• Collaborate with engineering teams on prompt engineering, AI workflow orchestration, human-in-the-loop review
processes, model evaluation frameworks, and continuous improvement initiatives.
• Facilitate integration requirements between AI platforms, Loan Origination Systems (LOS), CRM platforms, document
management systems, workflow engines, and enterprise data repositories.
• Lead validation activities for AI-generated outputs including document extraction accuracy, classification confidence
scoring, summarization quality, and decision-support recommendations.
• Establish governance controls for AI explainability, auditability, model monitoring, risk management, compliance reviews,
and responsible AI adoption.
• Manage Agile delivery processes including backlog prioritization, sprint planning, stakeholder reviews, dependency
management, release planning, and deployment coordination.
• Monitor key business metrics including loan processing turnaround time, document extraction accuracy, underwriting
efficiency, straight-through processing rates, and operational cost reduction within D365 platform
Tools & Technologies:
Generative AI | Agentic AI | LLMs | OCR | NLP | RAG | Vector Databases | Embeddings | Prompt Engineering | AI Workflow
Orchestration | Intelligent Document Processing (IDP) | Azure OpenAI | Power BI | JIRA | Confluence | SharePoint | Agile
Scrum | Loan Origination Systems (LOS) | API Integrations | Data Governance

entry.text: Project  1: Workday HCM & Talent Management Transformation

projects.name: Project Description
details: Led business analysis activities for the implementation and enhancement of Workday HCM, Talent Management,
Compensation, and Recruiting modules for a global enterprise workforce. The initiative focused on modernizing HR
operations, improving employee experience, automating workforce processes, and enabling real-time workforce analytics
through Workday and integrated enterprise applications.
Business Objectives
• Standardize global HR processes across multiple regions and business units.
• Automate employee lifecycle management from hire to retire.
• Improve talent acquisition, performance management, and compensation planning.
• Enable workforce reporting and HR analytics through centralized data management.
• Integrate Workday with Payroll, Identity Management, ERP, and third-party HR applications.
Key Responsibilities
• Conducted stakeholder workshops with HR, Talent Acquisition, Payroll, Compliance, and IT teams to gather and analyze
business requirements.
• Documented Business Requirements Documents (BRD), Functional Requirements Documents (FRD), process flows, user
stories, and acceptance criteria.
• Configured and validated requirements for Workday HCM, Recruiting, Talent Management, Compensation, Absence
Management, and Security roles.
• Facilitated requirement discussions for employee onboarding, offboarding, job changes, promotions, transfers, and
organizational restructuring processes.
• Collaborated with Workday consultants and solution architects to define business processes, security models, and reporting
requirements.
• Defined integration requirements between Workday and Payroll, Active Directory, ERP, ServiceNow, and third-party HR
systems.
• Participated in data migration activities including employee master data validation, cleansing, mapping, and reconciliation.
• Supported Workday EIB, Workday Studio, and API-based integration requirements.
• Managed product backlog, sprint planning, backlog grooming, and sprint reviews in Agile Scrum environments.
• Coordinated SIT, UAT, defect management, and business sign-off activities.
• Partnered with reporting teams to define HR dashboards and workforce analytics using Workday Reporting and Power BI.
• Ensured compliance with organizational security, privacy, and regulatory requirements.
Tools & Technologies
Workday HCM | Workday Recruiting | Talent Management | Compensation | Absence Management | Workday Reporting |
EIB | Workday Studio | JIRA | Azure DevOps | Power BI | ServiceNow | Active Directory | REST APIs | SQL | Agile Scrum
Key Achievements
• Streamlined employee lifecycle processes through automation and workflow optimization.
• Improved HR operational efficiency by reducing manual interventions across onboarding and talent management
processes.
• Enhanced workforce reporting accuracy through centralized employee data and real-time analytics.
• Successfully delivered Workday enhancements and integrations within Agile release cycles while maintaining stakeholder
alignment.

projects.name: Healthcare Claims Modernization – Guidewire ClaimCenter
details: • Elicited and documented business, functional, and regulatory requirements for healthcare claims processing systems.
• Facilitated workshops, stakeholder interviews, and JAD sessions with business and compliance teams.
• Developed BRDs, FSDs, user stories, process flows, and requirements traceability matrices.
• Created AS-IS and TO-BE workflows covering claims intake, adjudication, eligibility verification, pre-authorizations, and EOB
processing.
• Collaborated with solution architects and development teams on Guidewire ClaimCenter integrations.
• Defined data mapping requirements and validated Azure Data Factory migration pipelines.
• Supported API, FHIR, and EDI X12 integrations with healthcare partners, TPAs, and clearinghouses.
• Ensured HIPAA and ACA compliance through business process and data governance controls.
• Led UAT planning, execution, defect management, and stakeholder sign-offs.
• Worked with BI teams to define operational dashboards and claims reporting using Power BI.

details: • Elicited and documented business, functional, and regulatory requirements for healthcare claims processing systems.
• Facilitated workshops, stakeholder interviews, and JAD sessions with business and compliance teams.
• Developed BRDs, FSDs, user stories, process flows, and requirements traceability matrices.
• Created AS-IS and TO-BE workflows covering claims intake, adjudication, eligibility verification, pre-authorizations, and EOB
processing.
• Collaborated with solution architects and development teams on Guidewire ClaimCenter integrations.
• Defined data mapping requirements and validated Azure Data Factory migration pipelines.
• Supported API, FHIR, and EDI X12 integrations with healthcare partners, TPAs, and clearinghouses.
• Ensured HIPAA and ACA compliance through business process and data governance controls.
• Led UAT planning, execution, defect management, and stakeholder sign-offs.
• Worked with BI teams to define operational dashboards and claims reporting using Power BI.
